### Tone Notes
Tone:  Urgent, action-oriented, empowering, clear, concise, warm, supportive

### Length Guide
150-400 words

### Key Elements
- Important message
- Clear CTA button or link
- Signature with personal touch

### Example Opening
Subject:  Get Your Free Trial Today

Dear Friend,

We are excited to announce our newest product.
In the next 24 hours, you can try out our revolutionary product for yourself.

If you're interested in learning more, please reply to this email with your name and email address.

You'll receive a link to our trial offer and a special promo code that will get you 10% off your first purchase.

We look forward to hearing from you.

- The Power of Personal Transformation



## Vocabulary Guidelines
### Power Words to Use
determined, awaken, empower, create, waiting, community, chance, together, already, belong, take, joy, achievement, become, evolve, unstoppable, commit, share, tribe, move

### Signature Phrases
- "Here's the truth..."
- "What if I told you..."
- "Let me share something with you..."
- "Can I be honest with you?"
- "Imagine this..."

### Phrases to Avoid
- "Buy now!"
- "Limited time only!"
- "Act fast!"
- "Don't miss out!"
- "Only X spots left!"
